text:
Alex: Quick proposal — I want to try a short-cycle follow-up process for postmortems to stop action items from stalling. idea: 72h checkpoint, 2-week remediation sprint, 8-week recurrence review.
Maya: +1. can we make the 72h a lightweight check (status + blocker) so folks don't block for details? :ok_hand:
Priya: love the cadence. can you sketch the exact timeline/template? small things are easier to adopt.
Alex: sure, draft below — minimal fields so it's easy to update in-place. paste into the thread and we can iterate:
```
Postmortem follow-up timeline (compact)
- T+0 (postmortem published): assign remediation owner(s) and due dates
- T+72h: checkpoint (short update: on-track / blocked / needs help)
- T+7d: dev notes & mitigation PR link (if applicable)
- T+14d: remediation sprint end — close or extend with reason
- T+28d: quality check for regressions (run alert replay & eval)
- T+56d: recurrence pattern review (if repeats, escalate to infra/product)
Owners: one primary owner + one buddy
Communication: status pinned in PR + brief thread update
Automation: oncall-bot pings at T+72h and T+14d
```
Omar: Nice. For owners, can we add a required "remediation impact estimate" field? helps prioritization: low/med/high + expected dev hours.
Maya: Also recommend a comms cadence template for execs vs eng channels. Execs: weekly summary until closed. Eng channels: T+72h and T+14d updates.
Priya: Thinking about rotation — propose incident commander rotation be 1 week, with a 3-week overlap for handoffs in busy periods. The IC should be listed on the postmortem root so follow-ups know who to ping.
Alex: Great call. I'll add this to the process doc and wire the oncall-bot triggers:
- @oncall-bot remind #<private-action-tracker> T+72h "PM follow-up: <link>"
- @oncall-bot remind owner T+14d "Remediation due"
Priya: Can we tag a backlog label in Jira so tickets show in the oncall dashboard? e.g., label: pm-remediation.
Omar: +1. also suggest we make a simple recurring check run that replays the incident signals (small script) at T+28d to surface regressions automatically.
EngLead: This looks actionable — try it for the next 6 incidents as a pilot. capture metrics: time-to-close, percent with owner assigned within 24h, recurrence within 8 weeks.
oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: T+72h ping set for thread 1939991111.
Maya: I'll volunteer to be pilot coordinator — will run the first 6 closure reviews and collect the metrics.
Alex: thanks — I'll update the process doc and add the compact template + example checklist link: https://docs.internal/redwood/incident-followup-template
Priya: one more thing — add a tiny suggested message for owners to post at T+72h to keep entries consistent. e.g., "Status: on-track. PR: <link>. Blockers: none."
Alex: done (added in doc). let's reconvene after the 6-incident pilot and see if we tighten or loosen cadence. :rocket:
